```{r echo=FALSE}
# loading packages
package_loader <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% installed.packages()) {
    suppressMessages({
      library(x, character.only = TRUE)
    })
  } else {
    suppressMessages({
      install.packages(x)
      library(x, character.only = TRUE)
    })
  }
}
```

## read in data
```{r echo=FALSE}
all_data <- list.files("operations/reporting/pwqn_data_report/data", 
                       pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_df(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

pwqn_data <- all_data |>
  filter(value_final != "n/a") |> 
  mutate(DateTime_UTC = with_tz(DateTime_UTC, tz = "MST")) |> 
  rename(DateTime_MT = DateTime_UTC) |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(DateTime_MT),
    month = month(DateTime_MT),
    year_month = floor_date(DateTime_MT, unit = "month")) |> 
  left_join(labels, by = c( "parameter" = "param")) |> 
  left_join(site_names, by = "site") |> 
  filter(site_name != "NA")

pwqn_data_clean <- pwqn_data |>
  distinct(DateTime_MT, site_name, parameter, .keep_all = TRUE)

print(paste("Original records:", nrow(pwqn_data)))
print(paste("Records after removing duplicates:", nrow(pwqn_data_clean)))
print(paste("Duplicates removed:", nrow(pwqn_data) - nrow(pwqn_data_clean)))

check_duplicates <- pwqn_data_clean |>
  group_by(DateTime_MT, site_name, parameter) |>
  filter(n() > 1)

print(paste("Duplicates remaining:", nrow(check_duplicates)))

counts <- pwqn_data_clean |> 
  count(site = "archery", parameter = "pH", month = 2)

```


# Graphs
```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}
site_order <- site_names$site_name

#yearly
yearly_percent <- pwqn_data_clean |> 
  left_join(site_names, by = "site_name") |>
  group_by(year, parameter, site_name) |>
  summarise(actual_records = n(),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  mutate(expected_records = if_else(
      leap_year(year),
      366 * 24 * 60 / 15,
      365 * 24 * 60 / 15),
    data_pct = (actual_records / expected_records) * 100,
    site_name = factor(site_name, levels = site_order)) |> 
  arrange(year)

yearly_plot <- yearly_percent |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = data_pct, fill = site_name)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Site",
    values = setNames(site_names$site_color, site_names$site_name)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Data Availability by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Availability (%)",
    fill = "Site") +
  ylim(0, 105)

yearly_plot


#monthly
monthly_percent <- pwqn_data_clean |> 
  mutate(month = month(DateTime_MT),
         year = year(DateTime_MT)) |> 
  group_by(year, month, parameter, site_name) |>
  summarise(actual_records = n(),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  mutate(days_in_month = case_when(
      month == 2 ~ if_else(year %in% c(2020, 2024), 29, 28),
      month %in% c(4, 6, 9, 11) ~ 30, TRUE ~ 31),
    expected_records = days_in_month * 24 * 60 / 15,
    data_pct = (actual_records / expected_records) * 100) |>
  left_join(site_names, by = "site_name") |>
  mutate(month_year = ym(paste(year, month, sep = "-")),
    site_name = factor(site_name, levels = site_order)) |> 
  arrange(month, month_year, parameter, site_name)

monthly_plot <- monthly_percent |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = month_year, y = data_pct, fill = site_name)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Site",
    values = setNames(site_names$site_color, site_names$site_name)) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "3 months") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Data Availability",
    x = "Month-Year",
    y = "Availability (%)",
    fill = "Site") +
  ylim(0, 105) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

monthly_plot
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = value_final, fill = site_name)) +

  filter(!parameter %in% log_params) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = value_final, fill = site_name)) +
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}
#bands
pct_bands <- list(
  list(ymin = "p0",  ymax = "p5",   label = "Extreme (<5% / >95%)",              color = "#8E857A"),
  list(ymin = "p5",  ymax = "p10",  label = "Much below/above (5-10% / 90-95%)", color = "#E8DAB2"),
  list(ymin = "p10", ymax = "p25",  label = "Below/above normal (10-25% / 75-90%)", color = "#F0F7EB"),
  list(ymin = "p25", ymax = "p75",  label = "Normal range (25-75%)",             color = "#9CC4DE"),
  list(ymin = "p75", ymax = "p90",  label = "Below/above normal (10-25% / 75-90%)", color = "#F0F7EB"),
  list(ymin = "p90", ymax = "p95",  label = "Much below/above (5-10% / 90-95%)", color = "#E8DAB2"),
  list(ymin = "p95", ymax = "p100", label = "Extreme (<5% / >95%)",              color = "#8E857A")
)

band_colors <- setNames(
  vapply(pct_bands, `[[`, "", "color"),
  vapply(pct_bands, `[[`, "", "label")
)[!duplicated(vapply(pct_bands, `[[`, "", "label"))]

#daily summary function
daily_summary <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = c(0, .05, .10, .25, .75, .90, .95, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(p0 = q[1], p5 = q[2], p10 = q[3], p25 = q[4],
         p75 = q[5], p90 = q[6], p95 = q[7], p100 = q[8],
         Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

#remove legend duplicates
updated_legend <- function(p) {
  seen <- character(0)
  for (i in seq_along(p$x$data)) {
    nm <- p$x$data[[i]]$name
    if (is.null(nm)) next
    
    # strip wrapping "(" ")" and trailing ",<number>" that ggplotly adds per facet panel
    clean_nm <- sub("^\\((.*),\\d+\\)$", "\\1", nm)
    
    if (clean_nm %in% seen) {
      p$x$data[[i]]$showlegend <- FALSE
    } else {
      seen <- c(seen, clean_nm)
      p$x$data[[i]]$name <- clean_nm   # restore clean label for the one that's shown
    }
  }
  p
}

#temps plot
historic_temps_all_sites <- function(data = pwqn_data_clean,
                                      plot_title = "Historical Water Temperature Statistics by Site",
                                      sites = c("Canyon Mouth", "Tamasag", "Legacy", "Lincoln",
                                                "Timberline", "Prospect", "Boxelder", "Archery", "River Bluffs"),
                                      incl_winter = FALSE,
                                      temp_param_name = "Temperature") {

  temp_df <- data |>
    filter((site_name %in% sites | site %in% sites),
           grepl(temp_param_name, parameter, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (nrow(temp_df) == 0) stop("No temperature data found for the specified sites.")

  temp_data <- temp_df |>
    mutate(datetime = as.Date(DateTime_MT),
           month_day = format(datetime, "%m-%d"),
           value = value_final) |>
    filter(!is.na(value))
  if (!incl_winter) temp_data <- filter(temp_data, !month(datetime) %in% c(12, 1, 2))

  ref_year <- 2000
  daily_stats <- temp_data |>
    group_by(site_name, month_day) |>
    reframe(daily_summary(value)) |>
    mutate(plot_date = as.Date(paste0(ref_year, "-", month_day), "%Y-%m-%d")) |>
    filter(!is.na(plot_date)) |>
    arrange(site_name, plot_date) |>
    mutate(site_name = factor(site_name, levels = sites))

  ribbon_layers <- lapply(pct_bands, function(b) {
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = .data[[b$ymin]], ymax = .data[[b$ymax]], fill = b$label))
  })

  p <- ggplot(daily_stats, aes(x = plot_date)) +
    ribbon_layers +
    geom_line(aes(y = Mean, color = "Daily Average (Mean)"), linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~site_name, ncol = 3, scales = "fixed") +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Percentile Range", values = band_colors, breaks = names(band_colors)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Daily Average (Mean)" = "#222222")) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "2 months") +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "", y = "Temperature (°C)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

  gp <- ggplotly(p)
  updated_legend(gp)
}

all_sites_temp_plot2 <- historic_temps_all_sites(pwqn_data_clean)
all_sites_temp_plot2
```

# Interactive Tables
```{r}
library(kableExtra)

format_availability_kable <- function(data, col_names, align_vec) {
  data |>
    kable(
      format = "html",
      col.names = col_names,
      align = align_vec
    ) |>
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
      full_width = FALSE
    ) |>
    row_spec(
      0, 
      bold = TRUE, 
      color = "white", 
      background = "darkblue"
    )
}

# yearly

    .groups = 'drop'
```
